provenance.section: Ticker — "Real-time price updates every time a match happens."
modifications: price changed from "21932.98" to "21932.99" and volume_24_h advanced, modelling a match that moved the last price.
The four best_* fields are UNCHANGED from the documented example. That is the whole point of the fixture: the channel emits on every match, and a match need not move the top of book.

expectation: Parses. Produces NO ReferenceTopOfBookChanged when it follows ticker-snapshot on the same subscription generation, because the top of book did not change and the event means a change. Emits a COINBASE_TOP_OF_BOOK_UNCHANGED anomaly and increments topOfBookUnchangedSuppressed.
